articles.title: Severe drought declared and hosepipe bans in force - is your area affected?
articles.description: Parts of southern England have entered "severe drought", while about 30 million people are under hosepipe ban.
articles.summary: Severe drought has been declared in parts of southern England after months of dry weather drove some reservoirs to exceptionally low levels.
key_points: Most of England and all of Wales were already under drought conditions after both nations' hottest summers on record, which has taken its toll on rivers, crops and nature.
Roughly 30 million people across parts of England and Wales are covered by hosepipe bans, as part of water companies' efforts to manage supplies.
"Severe drought" - the highest category - has now been declared for parts of Cornwall, Devon, Dorset, Somerset, East Sussex and West Sussex .
